app.title.zh: 人生七年：从 7 岁到 70 岁

overview.title.zh: 14 个人，从 7 岁到 70 岁

overview.lede.zh: 选一个年龄，看每个人那时的状态；选几个人，看他们每个年龄的状态；两样都选，只看这几个人在那个年龄。图上的年龄、点和名字也能直接点。
overview.lede.en: Pick an age to see everyone then, pick people to see them at every age, or pick both for just them at that age. The chart is clickable too.

overview.lifelineAria.zh: 14 位人物在十部影片中的出镜生命线
overview.lifelineAria.en: Lifelines of the 14 participants across the ten films

legend.absent.zh: 未出镜 / 只有旧片段

person.questions.zh: 在问题库中查看全部 {n} 个问题
person.questions.en: See all {n} questions in the library

questions.lede.zh: 十部片里导演问过的问题。点开一条，可以看到回答要点、出处，以及同一个人在其他年龄被问到的同类问题。
questions.lede.en: Questions the film-makers asked across the ten films. Open one to see the answer in brief, the source, and similar questions to the same person at other ages.

questions.empty.zh: 没有找到符合条件的问题。

questions.related.zh: 同类问题 · 其他年龄

guess.title.en: Guess: does seven make the man?

guess.lede.zh: 每轮给出一个孩子 1964 年的出身和 7 岁时说的话，猜猜这个人最后的样子。三个选项都是真实的结局，其中两个属于别人。
guess.lede.en: Each round shows one child’s 1964 background and something they said at seven. Guess where they ended up. All three options are real outcomes — two belong to other people.

guess.noPrompt.en: Their words at seven could not be confirmed.

guess.question.en: Where do you think this child ended up?

guess.score.zh: 已经猜了 {n} 个，猜中 {k} 个

guess.done.zh: 你从 7 岁看到了最后，{n} 个人里猜中了 {k} 个。
guess.done.en: From seven to the end: you got {k} of {n}.

guess.doneSub.zh: 这部片的出发点是“七岁看老”。你的结果，离它有多远？
guess.doneSub.en: The series began with “give me the child until seven”. How close did you come?

guess.hiddenName.zh: 名字先藏起来，揭晓时再显示。
guess.hiddenName.en: The name stays hidden until you reveal.

origins.kicker.zh: 英国纪录片《人生七年》（Up 系列），1964—2026

origins.themesTitle.zh: 导演问了什么，想了解什么
origins.themesTitle.en: What the film-makers asked, and why

origins.themesLede.zh: 按主题整理。每张卡片给出一个代表性的问题，以及这类问题背后的意图：有出处的引用原话，没有出处的标为“解读”。点开进入问题库。
origins.themesLede.en: Grouped by theme. Each card shows a representative question and the intent behind it — quoted where a source says so, marked “interpretation” where it does not. Click to open the library.

about.purpose.zh: 这是一个个人整理的可视化项目，与 ITV、BBC 及影片制作方没有关联。
about.purpose.en: An independent visualization. Not affiliated with ITV, the BBC or the film-makers.

about.sources.zh: 所有事实都来自公开资料：维基百科、新闻报道与影评、访谈，以及影片本身。每条事实都标了出处；查不到的就写“未查到”，不做推测。
about.sources.en: Every fact comes from public sources — Wikipedia, news coverage and reviews, interviews, and the films themselves — and carries its source. Where nothing could be found the page says “Not found” rather than guessing.

about.copyright.zh: 片中内容只收录导演提问的原文；回答用我们自己的话转述。原话摘录每人每部片最多 3 条、每条不超过两句。不收录截图、视频或字幕全文。
about.copyright.en: From the films we include the interviewers’ questions verbatim; answers are paraphrased in our own words. Direct quotes are capped at three per person per film, two sentences each. No stills, video or full transcripts.

about.translation.zh: 中文译文由 AI 翻译，可能有不准确之处；在中文模式下，鼠标悬停在问答上可以看到英文原文。
about.translation.en: Chinese translations are machine-made (AI) and may be imperfect; in Chinese mode, hover over a question or quote to see the English original.

about.gaps.zh: 已知缺口：14 人 × 10 个年龄 × 6 个维度共 840 格，其中 545 格有出处，219 格未查到，76 格因缺席或去世不适用。70 Up（2026）播出不久，公开资料较少。一些新闻网站拒绝了我们的抓取工具，我们没有绕过；The Guardian、The Independent 和 Slant 的文章由使用者提供原文。早期几部按主题剪辑，很多问题无法确认是问谁的，只归到影片。
about.gaps.en: Known gaps: of the 840 cells (14 people × 10 ages × 6 dimensions), 545 are sourced, 219 could not be found and 76 do not apply (absent or deceased). 70 Up (2026) is recent, so public coverage is thin. Some news sites refused our fetching tool and we did not work around them; the Guardian, Independent and Slant articles were supplied as text by the user. The early films are cut by topic, so many questions can only be attributed to the film, not to a person.

people.lede.zh: 系列跟拍的 14 个人，按 1964 年的出身分组。点一张卡片，看这个人从 7 岁到 70 岁的经历。
people.lede.en: The fourteen people the series follows, grouped by where they started in 1964. Open a card to follow one life from 7 to 70.

edit.viewFile.zh: 在 GitHub 上查看数据文件
edit.viewFile.en: View the data file on GitHub

edit.needsTranslation.zh: 我只会写一种语言，请审核者帮忙翻译另一种
edit.needsTranslation.en: I can only write one language; please translate the other

edit.src.hint.zh: 填公开网页的地址，例如新闻、访谈或维基百科。不要用字幕网站。
edit.src.hint.en: Use a public web page such as a news story, an interview or Wikipedia. No subtitle sites.

edit.reasonHint.zh: 哪里不对？你是怎么知道的？
edit.reasonHint.en: What is wrong, and how do you know?

edit.submitNote.zh: 需要 GitHub 账号。提交后，审核者核对出处并批准，修改才会上线。
edit.submitNote.en: Needs a GitHub account. A reviewer checks the sources and approves before the change goes live.

edit.long.zh: 内容较长，放不进链接。请先“复制建议内容”，再粘贴到打开的页面里的“修改内容”一栏。
edit.long.en: This change is too long for a link. Copy the suggestion first, then paste it into the “Change” field on the page that opens.

edit.copyFallback.zh: 无法自动复制，请手动复制下面的文字。
edit.copyFallback.en: Couldn’t copy automatically; copy the text below.

edit.readonly.zh: 影片本身的出处不能修改。

edit.conflict.zh: 这条数据在你打开后已经变了，请关闭后重新打开。
edit.conflict.en: This record changed after you opened it. Close and reopen it.

check.MISSING_SOURCE.zh: 有出处的事实至少要有一个出处；网页出处需要 http(s) 开头的地址。
check.MISSING_SOURCE.en: A sourced fact needs at least one source, and a web source needs an http(s) address.

check.MISSING_LANG.en: Fill in both Chinese and English.

check.MISSING_LANG_ok.zh: 有一种语言空着，审核者会帮忙翻译。
check.MISSING_LANG_ok.en: One language is empty; the reviewer will translate it.

check.DANGLING_REF.zh: 引用了不存在的出处、问题或人物。
check.DANGLING_REF.en: This refers to a source, question or person that doesn’t exist.

check.BAD_ENUM.en: One of the choices isn’t valid.

check.QUOTE_LIMIT.zh: 每人每部片最多 3 条原话。
check.QUOTE_LIMIT.en: At most 3 quotes per person per film.

check.QUOTE_TOO_LONG.en: A quote can be at most two sentences.

check.FORBIDDEN_DOMAIN.zh: 不能使用字幕网站作为出处。
check.FORBIDDEN_DOMAIN.en: Subtitle sites can’t be used as sources.

check.STATE_PARTICIPATION_CONFLICT.zh: 这一部本人没有出镜，只能在“重大事件”里写事后得知的事。
check.STATE_PARTICIPATION_CONFLICT.en: They weren’t filmed for this one, so only Key events (learned later) can hold a fact.

check.FILM_SOURCE_URL.en: Film sources don’t take a URL.

data.title.en: The data, and how to fix it

data.lede.zh: 网站上的每一条事实都来自这里的数据。发现错误，或者知道“未查到”的内容，都可以提出修改；审核通过后网站会自动更新。
data.lede.en: Every fact on this site comes from this data. If you spot an error, or know something we couldn’t find, suggest a change; once a reviewer approves it, the site updates.

data.step1.zh: 在人物页、问题库或总览展开的卡片上，点 ✎ 建议修改。
data.step1.en: On a person page, in the question library or on an opened overview card, click ✎ Suggest a change.

data.step2.zh: 改正内容，附上公开网页的出处，写一句说明。
data.step2.en: Correct the text, add a public source and say why.

data.step3.zh: 在 GitHub 上提交（需要账号）。审核者核对后批准，网站自动更新。
data.step3.en: Submit it on GitHub (an account is needed). A reviewer checks and approves it, and the site updates.

data.rules.zh: 规则：每条事实都要有出处；回答用自己的话转述，原话每条不超过两句；不要使用字幕网站。
data.rules.en: Rules: every fact needs a source; answers are paraphrased and quotes are at most two sentences; no subtitle sites.

data.todoLede.zh: 这些格子还没有找到出处。如果你知道，点“补充”。
data.todoLede.en: No source has been found for these yet. If you know, click Fill in.

data.dlNote.zh: CSV 可以用 Excel、Numbers 或 Google 表格打开。
data.dlNote.en: CSV files open in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.

data.filesLede.zh: 数据保存在 GitHub 上的 data 文件夹里：每个人一个状态文件，每部片一个问题文件。
data.filesLede.en: The data lives in the data folder on GitHub: one state file per person and one question file per film.

data.report.zh: 其他问题（例如漏收的问题、界面文字）
data.report.en: Something else (a missing question, interface text…)
